Hi, This is not a mistake; the [product_name] can only perform calculations using integer format. If you want to display decimal values, there are some workarounds available. Check out the attached example showing how to make the [product_name] show the correct value. Also, our expert [user_name] has compiled some useful tips and tricks at [url]. Regards,

analysis.insight_summary: Users noticed that mathematical blocks in this product only calculate with integers, causing decimal results to be shown incorrectly. This can result in confusion or inaccurate outcomes for users who expect calculations with decimals or floating-point numbers.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want the mathematical function block to support decimal or floating-point calculations and display the correct output for non-integer values.
